name: 反応パネルの分類ショートカット
prompt:
Create a faithful isolated mobile reaction-category strip image, exactly 390x62 pixels in proportion. Use the native preview as authority for geometry, color, icon order and stroke style. This is a slim horizontal category selector, not the full emoji picker or Slack screen. White canvas with one rounded pale-mint bar at x16 y8, about 358 wide and 43 high, with soft 12px corners.

Place exactly nine small, evenly spaced, muted-gray outline icons centered across the bar in this order: circled information i; smile face; person silhouette; framed landscape/image; five-point star; telephone handset; closed padlock; pushpin; plus sign. Keep centers near x38, 76, 114, 152, 190, 228, 266, 304 and 342. Use a consistent thin stroke, simple clean geometry and approximately 19-21px icon size. Keep all icons visually equal in weight and color; the preview does not show a selected item. No labels, text, emoji grid, search box, divider, active highlight, animation, shadow or extra icons.

Preserve the compact native layout and generous white margin around the bar. Use the original Slack screenshot only as broad context for a reaction-category selector; it shows a different category set, so do not copy its icons. The Japanese native component preview controls the exact nine icon categories. This strip has no text and no hyperlink.
reviewNotes: 第1版を実画像で目視。info、smile、person、image、star、phone、lock、pin、plusの9アイコンと淡いミントの角丸バーを保持。細いグレーアウトラインで、表示文字・リンクなし。内側のバー自体はnative 390x62に近いが、生成キャンバスはバーの上下に大きな白余白を持ち、全体比率がnativeと異なる。第2版ではバーのアイコンサイズ・順序・間隔を維持して上下の余白をnativeの小さな余白に詰め、390x62の短い横長クロップへ合わせる。needs-correction。所有者受入・編集可能性・実動作は未検証。
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。

inputReferences.role: Primary native preview: authoritative 390x62 Japanese Lighthouse reaction-category strip and icon sequence
Original Slack emoji-picker screenshot: category-selector context only; crop [15,761,375,797] in normalized-width-390 coordinates
